title: Material Blend 4-Mix Solo #19 (부채꼴·매끈 | 목재+흑요암금+나비날개비늘+뱀비늘)

Each transition zone follows a smooth, even, straight course, no fabric no seam no garment anywhere, every material fused to or erupting from her own living skin, covering her completely with no bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. extreme platform heels/boots blending the relevant materials at her feet, extra long nails each matching whichever region that hand falls in.
